title: Urban Fitness vs Flex Fitness
meta_desc: Compare Urban Fitness Wellington and Flex Fitness Auckland NZ on price, contract, facilities and overall value to find the best gym for your needs.
intro: Urban Fitness Wellington and Flex Fitness Auckland NZ cater to different fitness needs. Urban Fitness is a boutique gym specialising in HYROX training and Olympic weightlifting, while Flex Fitness is a budget-friendly option with 24/7 access. This comparison will help you decide which gym is best for you.

sections.heading: Price Comparison
sections.body: Urban Fitness Wellington costs $70 per week, with no lock-in contract and a 7-day trial for $70. In contrast, Flex Fitness Auckland NZ offers a more affordable option from $10 to $18 per week, also with no lock-in contract. Consider your budget and how often you plan to visit the gym when deciding between these two options.

sections.heading: Facilities and Locations
sections.body: Urban Fitness Wellington is located at 4 College St, Te Aro, and specialises in HYROX training and Olympic weightlifting. Flex Fitness Auckland NZ has multiple locations across Auckland, including Newmarket, CBD, and Mt Eden, offering 24/7 access. If you prioritize specialised training and coaching, Urban Fitness might be the better choice. For those who value convenience and flexibility, Flex Fitness could be more suitable.
list: Urban Fitness Wellington: Specialised HYROX training and Olympic weightlifting
Flex Fitness Auckland NZ: 24/7 access, multiple locations

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Urban Fitness Wellington and Flex Fitness Auckland NZ depends on your fitness goals, budget, and preferences. If you are a serious athlete or competitor looking for specialised coaching and training, Urban Fitness Wellington might be the better choice. However, if you are a casual gym-goer on a budget who values flexibility and convenience, Flex Fitness Auckland NZ could be the more suitable option. Consider your needs and priorities before making a decision. Additionally, don't forget to check if you are eligible for Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off for eligible members.
list: For serious athletes and competitors: Urban Fitness Wellington
For casual gym-goers on a budget: Flex Fitness Auckland NZ
